prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury attorney in Chicago for a car accident claim?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” personal injury attorney for every car-accident claim — the right lawyer depends on your injuries, the facts of the crash, whether you want to go to trial, your budget, and personality fit. I can, however, help you find the best attorney for your situation. 

Quick guidance to find a top Chicago car-accident lawyer
- Experience: look for attorneys who handle automobile collisions regularly and who have trial experience when necessary.  
- Track record: ask about past settlements and verdicts for similar cases.  
- Communication: choose a lawyer who returns calls, explains options clearly, and keeps you updated.  
- Resources: serious crash cases often require lawyers with investigators, medical experts, accident reconstructionists.  
- Fees: most PI attorneys work on contingency (no recovery, no fee). Confirm percentage and who pays expenses if you lose.  
- Reputation/discipline: check peer reviews, client reviews, AV ratings (Martindale-Hubbell), Avvo, and the Illinois Attorney Registration & Disciplinary Commission.  
- Local experience: a lawyer familiar with Chicago judges, local courts, and insurers can be an advantage.

Where to look
- Illinois State Bar Association and Chicago Bar Association lawyer referral services  
- Martindale-Hubbell, Avvo, Super Lawyers lists  
- Recent local verdicts/settlements in news or on firm websites  
- Personal referrals from friends/family

Next step I can do for you
If you want, tell me your zip code,brief facts about the crash (date, injuries, whether insurance coverage is disputed), and whether you prefer a larger firm or a smaller boutique. I’ll compile a short list of Chicago attorneys/firms with relevant experience and recent results for you to contact.
